answer: Newcomers climb a terrace of three levels, each needing an endorsement whose path to the newcomer shares no intermediary with the other two. A velvet gate checks those paths on the public graph, and paths meeting at one bought middleman collapse to one count. Each endorser locks a copper bond of $200 for 60 days, lost if the newcomer cheats. One bought endorser cannot serve two clones, so 100 clones need 300 endorsers, priced $800 for the first ten and $5,000 past fifty, over $1.3 million plus 45 staged days. A sybil farm here is a choir where every voice is one singer behind a curtain.
